about.title: Tulare Wrongful Death Claims
about.longDescription: When a fatal collision happens along Rt 137, Blackstone, Bardsley, or SR-99, the surviving family is left carrying grief and questions all at once. Tulare County recorded 1 traffic death alongside dozens of injury collisions in the most recent final crash year, and each one leaves behind people who now have to figure out how to move forward. California law gives certain surviving family members, starting with a spouse, domestic partner, or children, the right to pursue a wrongful death claim, and other dependents or heirs may qualify if none of those exist. LawProactive doesn't practice law; we connect Tulare residents with an independent attorney who can walk through what happened, explain the two-year filing deadline, and help sort through funeral costs, lost income, and the loss of a loved one's guidance and companionship. There's no cost to start a conversation, and no obligation to move forward.

whyChoose.title: Why Tulare Families Reach Out to LawProactive

items.title: Understanding Who Can File
items.desc: California limits wrongful death standing to specific people, spouses, domestic partners, and children first, then other dependents or heirs. An attorney can clarify where your family fits before any paperwork is filed.

items.title: Watching the Two-Year Clock
items.desc: California generally allows two years from the date of death to file, though claims against a government entity move on a much shorter timeline. Given how many claims hinge on this fact, getting matched with an attorney early matters.

items.title: No Fee Unless There's a Recovery
items.desc: Attorneys in our network work on contingency, meaning your family pays nothing upfront and nothing at all unless the case results in a recovery.

items.question: Who is allowed to bring a wrongful death claim in California?
items.answer: California law generally gives priority to a surviving spouse, domestic partner, or children. If none of those exist, other dependents or heirs may have standing to file. An attorney can review your family's specific situation to confirm eligibility.

items.question: Does a fatal crash on a road like SR-99 or Bardsley change how a claim works?
items.answer: The location itself doesn't change the legal standards, but it can affect how evidence is gathered, since public crash records for corridors like SR-99, Blackstone, and Bardsley may include useful details. An attorney can look into whether any records from the crash apply to your family's claim.

items.question: What kinds of losses can a wrongful death claim cover?
items.answer: Recoverable losses can include funeral and burial costs, the financial support the deceased would have provided, and the loss of love, companionship, and guidance. Every family's losses look different, and an attorney can help identify what applies to yours.

items.question: How much does it cost to talk to an attorney through LawProactive?
items.answer: Nothing. LawProactive is a free connection service, and attorneys in our network work on contingency, meaning there's no fee unless there's a recovery.
